numeric_model.notes: decimal.Decimal is available in the standard library but is not the default numeric type; ordinary arithmetic uses binary float/int, which does not preserve COBOL COMP-3 / PL/SQL NUMBER precision unless Decimal is deliberately used everywhere

concurrency_model: GIL-bound threads for I/O-bound work; asyncio for cooperative concurrency; multiprocessing for true parallelism
native_sql_access: DB-API 2.0 drivers (e.g. sqlite3, psycopg2); no built-in ORM
multiple_inheritance_notes: native multiple inheritance with MRO (C3 linearization)
notes: Drafted from general knowledge of the language, not yet checked by a project maintainer. Verify each field before treating target-fit findings derived from this file as final.
